subject: design-technology

moments.title: Watt's separate condenser
moments.body: Watt patents a steam engine with a separate condenser, dramatically reducing fuel use compared to Newcomen's design.
moments.takeaway: Incremental engineering changes can have civilisation-scale effects.

moments.title: Boulton and Watt partnership
moments.body: Boulton's Soho Manufactory provides the precision metalworking Watt's design demands.
moments.takeaway: Design needs manufacturing partners to scale.

moments.title: Watt (unit) adopted
moments.body: The unit of power is named after Watt, decades after his death. The James Watt steam engine reshaped what work was possible.
moments.takeaway: Engineers are sometimes remembered through the units that bear their name.

now.title: Power and design today
now.body: Energy efficiency is a primary product design metric. Embodied energy in manufacturing is harder to count.
now.open_questions: How do we redesign products for a low-carbon grid?

reflection: One Scottish engineer reset the relationship between human labour and energy.
